name: Skill Manager
description: Conservative skill optimization on an explicitly selected daemon node and authorized roots.

subcommands.name: configure
subcommands.description: Select a mesh node and authorized skill roots from a JSON configuration

subcommands.name: status
subcommands.description: Show selection, configuration and last report

subcommands.name: audit
subcommands.description: Inspect changed skill packages without applying changes

subcommands.name: optimize
subcommands.description: Run configured conservative optimization on the selected node

subcommands.name: route
subcommands.description: Suggest at most one skill using bounded metadata and optional existing decision assistance

tasks.intent: Inspect changed skills and apply only authorized lossless optimization
